historical_B0_source_comparability.scope: Two prespecified complete controls reproduce old ordered physical/RNG signatures under the new source; this is not a replay of all 100 old arms.

b1_preflight.receipt_note: Initial receipt assertion incorrectly required substring BSER in wrapper class name. Corrected to exact native BSEROnlineAllocator / safe SafeJointAllocator names after inspecting existing class hierarchy; no simulation, source or result was changed. Main scheduler started after actual prefix completion, before corrected receipt was saved.

limitations: Development scenes already used in B0 tuning; no independent generalization claim.
Pooled rate changes and mean per-scene paired changes have different weights.
Observation renewal and motion stall are diagnostic proxies, not detection probabilities.
No training, checkpoint loading, HGR execution, heldout80 evaluation or performance acceptance.
Intervals descriptive without multiplicity correction; transfer difference is effect heterogeneity, not mediation.
